name: Annual Tax Demand Notice
summary: An assessment from the Tax Authority of how much you owe (or are owed) for a given tax year, with a payment or appeal deadline.

guidance.primaryNextStep: Compare the reported income and amount due against your own records before you decide whether to pay or appeal.
guidance.deadlineSummary: By the payment date on the notice
guidance.appliesWhen: the Tax Authority says you owe money or need to respond about a specific tax year
guidance.recommendedChannel: Use the payment or objection channel printed on the notice and keep proof of every submission.
guidance.whenToContactAuthority: the income, amount due, or deadline does not match your records
guidance.whatToVerify: Verify the tax year, reported income, total amount due, and the final payment or objection deadline.

sections.explainer: Tax year: the year covered by the calculation. Check it before comparing records.
Reported income: the figure used to calculate tax. Compare your return and income evidence, including Form 106 where applicable.
sections.actionRequired: Compare income with your records. If it differs, check the challenge procedure and deadline on your notice.

sections.explainer: Amount owed: check tax, interest, linkage, penalties and credited payments separately. Clarify what a negative balance means on your assessment.
Payment deadline: use the date on your notice. Late payment may lead to additional charges or collection.
sections.actionRequired: Pay through the official channel on the notice and keep confirmation.
sections.deadline: By the payment date on the notice

sections.explainer: Challenging the calculation: check the procedure and deadline for your specific decision. State the tax year, case number and disputed item.
sections.actionRequired: For a complex calculation, consult a qualified tax professional before submitting a challenge.
sections.deadline: Within the challenge period stated on the notice

sources.title: רשות המסים — דע את זכויותיך וחובותיך 2024
sources.scope: Official explanatory guide covering assessments and refunds. Used for general document concepts only; no historical rate or filing deadline is applied to the reader’s notice.
